title: Behavioral Observational douleur échelle (BOPS) pour Post-Op pédiatrique douleur

how_to_use.pearls: Allows for simple, quick pain assessment in children 1-7 years old after surgery.

next_steps.advice: The BOPS is easy to use when assessing pediatric pain.
next_steps.critical_actions: The BOPS requires close and attentive clinical evaluation of facial expressions, vocalization and body language.

more_info:
Pain assessments should be performed:

- Every 3 hours
- 15-20 minutes after IV administration of analgesics
- 30-45 minutes after oral/rectal administration

**Consider analgesia for scores ≥ 3.**
medium_description: Quantifies post-operative douleur pour enfants aged 1-7 years.

options.label: Negative facial expression, grimace, distorted face
Completely quiet, sobbing et/ou complaining but not because de douleur
Crying, screaming et/ou complaining about douleur
Inactive, laying, relaxed avec all extremities ou sitting, walking
Restless movements, shifting fashion et/ou touching wound ou wound area
Lying rigid et/ou drawn up avec arms et legs pour body

references.text: Anand KJ, Craig KD. New perspectives on definition of pain. Pain 1996; 67:3-6.

Hesselgard K, Larsson S, Romner B, Strömblad LG, Reinstrup P. Validity and reliability of the Behavioural Observational Pain Scale for postoperative pain measurement in children 1-7 years of age. Pediatr Crit Care Med. 2007 Mar;8(2):102-8.
